instruction: Send $100 publicly on Venmo to the person with this phone number 5734599766.
notes: Supervisor profile supplies the login usernames (phone number for phone, email for venmo); passwords come from show_account_passwords. The contact's email is discovered via phone.search_contacts with the phone number as query (known-email). Card selection requires the current date (phone.get_current_date_and_time) so venmo-show-payment-cards requires (datetime-known) and yields (known-card) for a non-expired card. The requested transaction tx-1 is specified statically in :init (receiver = contact, amount-100, privacy = public i.e. private=false); venmo-create-transaction can only mark it (sent) with matching receiver/amount/privacy, which mirrors the evaluation's single added public $100 transaction to the contact's Venmo user. supervisor-complete-task takes the transaction record as a non-API parameter and is forced last.
